capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Ford: 33.5 kWh liquid-cooled lithium-ion pack (relayed by InsideEVs); 2017 and 2018 same pack.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Green Cars Compare 31.8 kWh usable; EV Database 29.0 and a Pod Point estimate 30.2 conflict (search excerpts only). Recorded the figure from the page opened. The repo model note also shows the 31.8 vs 29.0 kWh conflict; 31.8 is on the page opened (33.5 gross there).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Green Cars Compare states a "400 V architecture" for the 33 kWh car (the 23 kWh pack of the same car is 318 V nominal per DOE/INL).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Only an automatic active liquid cooling/heating thermal management system is described for the car (Wikipedia, InsideEVs: liquid-cooled); no page describes a navigation or manual battery preconditioning feature for the 2017-2018 Focus Electric. Not confirmed by an owner's manual. No owner's manual or maker statement found; owner decision requested.

dc_max_kw.notes: Ford: DC fast charging up to 50 kW over CCS (InsideEVs, Wikipedia).

ac_max_kw.notes: 6.6 kW onboard charger; the 2017 car kept the 2012-2016 charger.
